title: MoLE gates over Mirror-compressed logical LoRAs
hypothesis: A dynamic layerwise gate can compose many logical LoRA experts from shared Mirror atoms with the same held-out quality as full MoLE while reducing bank bytes and active expert compute; native shared-basis and top-k MoLE controls are required.
physical_object: Two frozen dense layer bases with eight LoRA experts per layer, represented by shared rank-1 atoms plus expert codes
mirror_coordinate: Per-layer/per-expert code over shared LoRA atoms; input-dependent MoLE gates mix codes before atom application
logical_multiplicity: Eight logical experts per layer and two layers of dynamically composed functions

task.metric: Held-out two-layer output NRMSE, actual serialized complete inference bytes, active MAC proxy and CPU inference wall time

development.selection_metric: Quality/storage/active-compute Pareto; no gate or expert ranks change after fresh access

controls: Full MoLE bank with per-layer LoRA expert factors and learned input gate
Full MoLE bank with top-2 gate as sparse active-compute control
Mirror shared atoms/codes with gate-code aggregation before basis application
Native shared-basis MoLE with identical factorization and gate-code aggregation
Shared-basis plus private rank-2 LoRA residuals, with matching native control

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all expert LoRA factors or shared atom bases

compute: active expert/atom MAC proxy per input
success_gate: At residual 0, shared Mirror output NRMSE <=0.02, complete bytes <=60% of full MoLE, and active MACs <=50% of full bank; at nonzero residual, private rank-2 mode must retain NRMSE <=0.02 and improve full-bank bytes or active compute. Mirror-specific success requires a strict frontier gain over native shared-basis MoLE.
failure_gate: Quality/storage/compute gate misses or Mirror exactly aliases native shared-basis MoLE without strict Pareto gain. Exact development alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic two-layer regression network only; not a MoLE or language-model reproduction
Router is an input-dependent softmax linear gate and its weights are charged
For the compressed path gate probabilities are applied to expert codes before shared atom evaluation
All expert banks, residuals, bases, gates and metadata are serialized
Expert count is not credited as independent capacity without measured composed-output quality
